video_title: 🚨EMERGENCY POD🚨 Giannis Traded To Heat In Blockbuster Deal With Bucks

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks trade Giannis Antetokounmpo to Heat for package of assets
quotes.excerpt: the Giannis Antetokounmpo saga in Milwaukee came to an end as there is an agreement

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Giannis Antetokounmpo saga in Milwaukee came to an end as there is an agreement for the Bucks to trade him alongside Bobby Portis to the Miami Heat for Tyler Herro, Kel'el Ware, Jaime Jaquez Jr., Kasparas Jakucionis, three first-round picks, a pick swap, and a second-round pick.

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: I think that was the only one they could trade. They only had one tradeable second, and they squeezed them out of it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks chose Heat offer over Celtics' Jaylen Brown package
quotes.excerpt: the Bucks had an offer from the Celtics including Jaylen Brown and multiple other assets

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: The Bucks had an offer from the Celtics including Jaylen Brown and multiple other assets. The Bucks, after having a lot of conversation and thought about it, had to choose one. They probably had a lot of discussion to choose this one.

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: It basically wipes the slate a little bit clean. If you are going to rebuild, you could probably rebuild a little bit easier this way. Although Jaylen Brown is a heck of a player, he is also owed 185, 190 million dollars over the next three years. You would be walking into a situation where it would be him, Bobby Portis, and Kyle Kuzma and some Gary Trent Jr. and that group and the 10th pick in the draft.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown in Milwaukee would have been a recipe for misery
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown in Milwaukee seemed like a recipe for misery because the Bucks with an MVP candidate
quotes.quote: Jaylen Brown in Milwaukee seemed like a recipe for misery because the Bucks with an MVP candidate are going to be a mediocre team. They were mediocre when Giannis played last year and bad when he didn't. Jaylen Brown is a very good player, but he is not a better player than Giannis. Shams reported it was Jaylen Brown and two first-round picks, and that was the offer. They didn't get that top-end talent in the return from Miami, but they squeezed pretty much everything they could squeeze out of it.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's contract control makes him a valuable trade asset
quotes.excerpt: he is under contract control for three more years, which is why I believe he is going
quotes.quote: He is under contract control for three more years, which is why I believe he is going to have significant value in a trade elsewhere. If you go back and look at the star players that have been traded in the last year, Kevin Durant, the primary piece in the package he was traded for a year ago was the 10th pick. Jaylen Green certainly, but the 10th pick was a prime piece in that. It was a decent return, but this return is greater.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Andrew Wiggins' contract status and trade eligibility
quotes.excerpt: Andrew Wiggins was kept out of this trade. By the way, they couldn't trade him.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Andrew Wiggins was kept out of this trade. By the way, they couldn't trade him. He hasn't picked up his option yet for next year. Andrew Wiggins is like, I haven't picked up my option, they're going to try and trade me, they're going to trade me.

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: You notice all those Milwaukee guys haven't picked up, except for Gary Harris, haven't picked up their option yet either. They're probably like, I don't want to be involved. Maybe they didn't want to be involved.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Heat face financial restrictions following Giannis trade
quotes.excerpt: the Heat don't have a ton of guys on their roster right now and they've now are
quotes.quote: The Heat don't have a ton of guys on their roster right now and they've now are going to be restricted a little bit in what they can spend. Because they are taking back more salary in a trade, they are now hard-capped at the first apron, so they are roughly 18 million dollars below the threshold, and that does not include free agent Norman Powell. So they have a lot of spots to fill to fill out the roster.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Andrew Wiggins' contract extension and Heat's financial flexibility
quotes.excerpt: if Wiggins opts into his contract, he makes 30 million. They could sign a new contract

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: If Wiggins opts into his contract, he makes 30 million. They could sign a new contract that is less than that that could give the Heat a little bit more to spend, right?

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: So you could basically, he can decline his option, you basically, let's hypothetical, lowers number to like 22, 23, and then add a second year and you basically make up the money and give him a little bit extra there. So that is a way to give yourself some more flexibility.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Heat's defensive identity with Bam Adebayo and Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: Bam Adebayo is an elite defensive player, all defensive type player can guard multiple different bigs.
quotes.quote: Bam Adebayo is an elite defensive player, all defensive type player can guard multiple different bigs. You look at Giannis obviously former defensive player of the year, that is terrific defense. Andrew Wiggins, strong plus perimeter defender. Those guys are going to be able to shoot, or I mean, they're going to be able to defend. They're going to have to hang their head on the defensive end.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' failed attempt to avoid Jaylen Brown's availability
quotes.excerpt: there was an attempt to I think try to avoid it Jaylen being flagrantly available

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: There was an attempt to I think try to avoid it Jaylen being flagrantly available, but that's the horse is out of the barn on that.

quotes.speaker: Tim Bontemps
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's pride is bruised by trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: it's the continuation of the relationship issues because whether he's been offered or not, whatever the semantics
quotes.quote: It's the continuation of the relationship issues because whether he's been offered or not, whatever the semantics are, he's been mentioned in trade rumors multiple times now throughout the course of his career. And this went beyond trade rumors. There's no question that he was offered here. And he already he addressed this on Twitch. He says to all the people that data me that that want me gone, you're turning me into a monster now. He's using his motivation, but this also comes fresh off of him blatantly saying, hey, this was my favorite year of my career. This not not the year they won the championship, but the year that he was the unquestioned man on the team was his favorite year of his career.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics' front office is actively exploring Jaylen Brown trade options
quotes.excerpt: if the Bucks chose the Heat package was who could trade for Jaylen Brown
quotes.quote: If the Bucks chose the Heat package was who could trade for Jaylen Brown. I'm not going to get into the speculation zone here because it'll get aggregated and it'll be reports. But assessing it, I think there's quite a few teams that can make compelling offers for him. None of them, unfortunately for the Celtics, will have Giannis in them. There's not going to be a player of that caliber coming back. But it's possible Jaylen Brown could land multiple players who could be high-level starters.

text_blocks.text: A three-team trade between Minnesota, Chicago and Brooklyn, the core piece of this being Julius Randle being sent in a there was some swapping around of picks. The Timberwolves sent out the 28th pick and got back the 33rd pick.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Had Steve Kerr not resigned in Golden State, I think Dusty May would have been on the Warriors short list. I think he was on the short list a couple of other places, and he was clearly on the short list for the Mavericks.

text_blocks.speaker: Bobby Marks
text_blocks.text: I think his personality is terrific. I think we said on the show tonight, or not tonight, yesterday, his demeanor is terrific, right? Like having gotten to know a lot of the Michigan players in this year's draft, that was the drawing point, Damaro and Murez Johnson, guys who have transferred in, Lindenberg too, was like his part like the personality, they just loved playing for him.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst

quotes.quote: Had Steve Kerr not resigned in Golden State, I think Dusty May would have been on the Warriors short list. I think he was on the short list a couple of other places, and he was clearly on the short list for the Mavericks. So I know that it came as some level of a surprise, but I think they probably would have hired him right away if it was an easy decision for him.
